name: eval03_灯塔
desc: 文学叙事（含词句卡）：which/who/that 定从、倒装过去完成（Never had…）、had been 双计、词句卡并入已知（keeper/gull/tide/stair/lighthouse）、专名一致性⑧

passive: It was built by Ben's grandfather more than sixty years ago.
Its white walls had been washed by ten thousand storms.
The letter was given to the island school, and everybody clapped for the young keeper at the morning meeting.
relcl: Ben's father, who kept the light before him, had gone to the town for the winter.
The boy lived there with a black cat and a radio that talked to him from across the sea.
Ben, who knew every step of the old stair, climbed up with a small lantern.
The lamp, which had never failed his family, was dry and cold.
A ship that carried tea and paper had passed the island safely at two in the morning.
Ben's grandfather, who loved this wild place more than any city, always said that a keeper's life was the best life in the world.
pastperf: Its white walls had been washed by ten thousand storms.
Ben's father, who kept the light before him, had gone to the town for the winter.
Never had Ben seen such a dark sea.
The lamp, which had never failed his family, was dry and cold.
He found the trouble at once: sea water had run into the oil box during the storm.
A ship that carried tea and paper had passed the island safely at two in the morning.
overlong: When the captain learned about the boy in the tower, he sent a long letter of thanks to the island school.
Ben's grandfather, who loved this wild place more than any city, always said that a keeper's life was the best life in the world.
